newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds were a little higher at the close on Thursday, supported by a firmer U.S. dollar boosted by a stronger-than-expected drop in the U.S. trade deficit in October, dealers said.
"The U.S. dollar supported the Spanish market which is set to close at today's high," a dealer in Madrid said. "That helped our market to overcome completely this morning's bad mood."
With little news on the domestic side and in a pre-holiday mood, the Spanish market was trading flat with little volume. Dealers did not expect any big movements on Friday.
